prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of proposals (ideology-neutral)

Economy and business
- Responsible public finances; restore trade ties with Europe; long-term industrial strategy.
- Invest in green infrastructure, innovation and skills; expand British Business Bank.
- Reform business rates into a Commercial Landowner Levy; strengthen late-payment rules.
- Targeted tax changes: reverse bank tax cuts; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; 4% levy on FTSE-100 buybacks; fairer capital gains.
- Digital and AI: clear cross-sector regulation; consumer data transparency; digital literacy target.

Jobs and work
- Replace apprenticeship levy with a flexible skills levy; Lifelong Skills Grants.
- New “dependent contractor” status; fair SSP from day one; Worker Protection Authority.
- Living wage review; flexible working as a day-one right.

Climate and energy
- Net zero by 2045; 90% renewable electricity by 2030.
- Ten-year home energy upgrade; zero‑carbon new builds; social energy tariff.
- Ban fracking and new coal; end fossil subsidies with a just transition.
- Expand storage, interconnectors and community energy; associate UK ETS with EU ETS.
- Corporate net-zero reporting; Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism.

Natural environment
- Overhaul water regulation; curb sewage discharges; “Sewage Tax.”
- Legally binding targets to “double nature” by 2050; plant 60m trees/year.
- Clean Air Act to WHO standards; stronger environmental regulators.
- Deposit return scheme; phase out non‑recyclable single-use plastics within three years.
- Peatland restoration; marine protected areas.

Health and social care
- GP appointments within 7 days (24 hours urgent); 8,000 more GPs; pharmacy first.
- NHS dentistry access; mental health hubs; school mental health professionals.
- Cancer: 62‑day treatment guarantee; more radiotherapy machines; cancer nurses.
- Free personal care; social care workforce plan; Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour).
- Ten‑year hospital estate plan; interoperable digital records.

Education and families
- Mental health professional in every school; real-terms per‑pupil funding increases.
- Tutoring guarantee; early years: extra free hours and higher EYPP.
- Maintenance grants restored; Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000).
- Parental leave/pay: double SMP/SPP to £350; extra month for fathers at 90%; day‑one rights incl. self‑employed.
- Return to Erasmus+; Young People’s Premium (16–18); SEND funding reforms.

Welfare and pensions
- Remove two‑child limit and benefit cap; reduce UC wait to 5 days.
- Replace sanctions with incentive-based employment support.
- Protect triple lock; address WASPI compensation; improve disability assessments.
- Increase and widen Carer’s Allowance eligibility.

Crime and justice
- Community policing; guaranteed police attendance for all burglaries.
- Online Crime Agency; scrap Police & Crime Commissioners for local Police Boards.
- Halve offence‑to‑sentence time; expand youth diversion; fraud reimbursements.
- Modern slavery protections; improve rehabilitation and resettlement.

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year, incl. 150,000 social; 10 garden cities.
- Ban no‑fault evictions; default three‑year tenancies; landlord register.
- Abolish leasehold; cap ground rents; remove dangerous cladding at no cost to leaseholders.
- Powers on second homes/short‑lets; rough sleeping plan; scrap Vagrancy Act.
- Multi‑year council funding; nationwide gigabit broadband.

Transport
- EV push: many more chargers, restored plug‑in grant, card access, 5% VAT on public charging.
- Freeze rail fares; simplify ticketing; rail electrification; Northern Powerhouse Rail.
- Bus franchising powers; £2 fare cap while fares reviewed; active travel networks.
- Shift more roads budget to maintenance and pothole repair.
- Aviation: R&D in zero‑carbon flight; tighter taxes; ban short flights with <2.5h rail alternative.

Culture, media and sport
- Protect BBC, S4C, Channel 4; Creative Europe participation.
- Easier EU touring for artists; anti‑SLAPP law; Leveson Part Two.
- Gambling levy, ad restrictions, affordability checks.
- Football regulator; expand free‑to‑air listed events.

Immigration and asylum
- End hostile environment; move work/student visa policy outside Home Office.
- Scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda plan; expand safe/legal routes.
- Three‑month asylum decision standard; right to work after 3 months.
- Flexible, sector‑led work visas; ease rules for NHS/care; expand Youth Mobility.
- Automatic Settled Status upgrades; Windrush compensation independent of Home Office.

Rights and equality
- Uphold Human Rights Act and ECHR.
- Race Equality Strategy; classify misogyny as hate crime; ban conversion practices.
- Day‑one flexible working; disabled right to work from home unless impracticable.
- Reform gender recognition; disability employment support; assisted dying free vote.

Political reform and devolution
- Proportional representation (STV) for MPs and English councils; votes at 16; scrap voter ID.
- Enshrine Ministerial Code; reform House of Lords; cap political donations.
- Citizens’ assemblies; transparency on lobbying and digital communications.
- Federal approach with stronger devolution to nations and English regions.

Defence
- Reverse Army cuts; aim for 2.5% of GDP on defence; maintain nuclear deterrent.
- Tougher arms export controls; procurement reform; stronger ISC.
- Improved housing, healthcare and benefits for service personnel and veterans.

International
- Rebuild relations with Europe via phased roadmap; seek Single Market entry longer term.
- Support Ukraine; seize frozen Russian assets for Ukrainian aid.
- Restore aid to 0.7% with poverty focus; fund BBC World Service.
- Israel–Gaza: immediate bilateral ceasefire; two‑state process; recognise Palestine.
- Human rights sanctions; Xinjiang import bans; support Hong Kongers and Taiwan.
